Personal archive · Notes from the process

Trying to understand things clearly — then seeing what can be built from them.

I’m Houcine. I’m interested in how ideas hold up under scrutiny, how people reach agreements, and how a thought becomes something useful in the world. This site is a record of that process: writing, research, experiments, and work that is still taking shape.
